en: Theragāthā 2.27 Dukanipāta, Tatiyavagga The Elder’s Verses 2.27 Second Book, Third Chapter: The Chapter on the Three Hundred (Tatiyavagga) I am one who has crossed over the flood; I have reached the further shore. Having abandoned all attachments, I dwell without clinging. I am one who has transcended all bonds; I am free from all ties. I am one who has attained peace; I am cooled and extinguished. I am one who has reached the goal; I have done what was to be done. I am one who bears his final body; I am a sage who has laid down the burden. I am one who has no more birth; I have reached the end of suffering. I am one who has realized Nibbāna; I am a victor in the battle. I am one who has seen the Dhamma; I am a seer of the Truth. I am one who has gone beyond the world; I am a conqueror of Māra. I am one who has no fear; I am free from all anxiety. I am one who has no sorrow; I am free from all lamentation. I am one who has no grief; I am free from all despair. I am one who has no fever; I am cooled by the nectar of peace. I am one who has no craving; I am free from all thirst. I am one who has no grasping; I am free from all attachment. I am one who has no conceit; I am free from all pride. I am one who has no delusion; I am awakened to the Truth. I am one who has no doubt; I have crossed over the ocean of existence. I am one who has no defilement; I am pure and stainless. I am one who has no stain; I am bright and radiant. I am one who has no darkness; I am illumined by wisdom. I am one who has no obstruction; I am open and unimpeded. I am one who has no fetter; I am liberated in every way. I am one who has no bond; I am released from all constraints. I am one who has no yoke; I am free from all burdens. I am one who has no thorn; I am healed of all pain. I am one who has no dart; I am pierced through the heart of ignorance. I am one who has no arrow; I am free from all piercing wounds. I am one who has no disease; I am healthy and whole. I am one who has no sickness; I am free from all illness. I am one who has no fever; I am cooled by the nectar of peace. I am one who has no passion; I am free from all lust. I am one who has no hatred; I am free from all aversion. I am one who has no delusion; I am awakened to the Truth. I am one who has no pride; I am humble and lowly. I am one who has no conceit; I am free from all arrogance. I am one who has no vanity; I am free from all self-importance. I am one who has no hypocrisy; I am sincere and honest. I am one who has no guile; I am straightforward and open. I am one who has no deceit; I am free from all trickery. I am one who has no crookedness; I am straight and upright. I am one who has no wickedness; I am gentle and kind. I am one who has no malice; I am free from all ill-will. I am one who has no anger; I am free from all resentment. I am one who has no wrath; I am free from all fury. I am one who has no vexation; I am free from all irritation. I am one who has no affliction; I am free from all distress. I am one who has no torment; I am free from all anguish. I am one who has no burning; I am cooled by the nectar of peace. I am one who has no heat; I am free from all feverish passion. I am one who has no flame; I am extinguished and at rest. I am one who has no smoke; I am clear and bright. I am one who has no cloud; I am free from all obscurity. I am one who has no rain; I am dry and firm. I am one who has no storm; I am calm and serene. I am one who has no wind; I am still and motionless. I am one who has no wave; I am deep and unfathomable. I am one who has no ripple; I am smooth and tranquil. I am one who has no current; I am free from all flow. I am one who has no eddy; I am free from all whirlpools. I am one who has no whirlwind; I am steady and unwavering. I am one who has no dust; I am clean and pure. I am one who has no mire; I am free from all mud. I am one who has no swamp; I am firm and solid. I am one who has no quagmire; I am free from all sinking. I am one who has no pit; I am level and even. I am one who has no abyss; I am free from all precipices. I am one who has no cliff; I am safe and secure. I am one who has no danger; I am free from all peril. I am one who has no fear; I am fearless and brave. I am one who has no terror; I am free from all alarm. I am one who has no dread; I am free from all anxiety. I am one who has no trembling; I am steadfast and firm. I am one who has no shaking; I am immovable and stable. I am one who has no wavering; I am unwavering and constant. I am one who has no fluctuation; I am unchanging and eternal. I am one who has no variation; I am uniform and consistent. I am one who has no difference; I am undivided and whole. I am one who has no duality; I am non-dual and absolute. I am one who has no conflict; I am free from all strife. I am one who has no dispute; I am free from all contention. I am one who has no quarrel; I am free from all bickering. I am one who has no strife; I am free from all discord. I am one who has no battle; I am free from all combat. I am one who has no war; I am free from all conflict. I am one who has no fight; I am free from all struggle. I am one who has no contest; I am free from all rivalry. I am one who has no competition; I am free from all emulation. I am one who has no rivalry; I am free from all envy. I am one who has no jealousy; I am free from all envy. I am one who has no pride; I am free from all arrogance. I am one who has no vanity; I am free from all self-conceit. I am one who has no conceit; I am free from all self-importance. I am one who has no delusion; I am awakened to the Truth. I am one who has no ignorance; I am possessed of wisdom. I am one who has no blindness; I am possessed of vision. I am one who has no darkness; I am illumined by light. I am one who has no obscurity; I am clear and bright. I am one who has no gloom; I am radiant and glorious. I am one who has no shadow; I am free from all concealment. I am one who has no veil; I am open and transparent. I am one who has no screen; I am free from all barriers. I am one who has no covering; I am naked and bare. I am one who has no disguise; I am true to myself. I am one who has no pretense; I am free from all hypocrisy. I am one who has no artifice; I am simple and plain. I am one who has no craftiness; I am free from all guile. I am one who has no cunning; I am straightforward and honest. I am one who has no deception; I am free from all trickery. I am one who has no fraud; I am free from all deceit. I am one who has no falsehood; I am truthful and sincere. I am one who has no lie; I am free from all untruth. I am one who has no error; I am free from all mistake. I am one who has no fault; I am blameless and pure. I am one who has no blemish; I am flawless and perfect. I am one who has no stain; I am stainless and spotless. I am one who has no taint; I am free from all defilement. I am one who has no impurity; I am pure and clean. I am one who has no pollution;
The Verses of the Elder Nandaka:
Having gained even greater spiritual urgency,
he bears his burden without dejection.
Thus is one endowed with vision.
“A disciple of the Perfectly Enlightened One—
a legitimate son of the Buddha.”
